title: [Profile Request] Milesight - EM410-RDL
body:
### Device Vendor

Milesight

### Device Model

EM410-RDL

### Product Manual/Datasheet Link

https://example.com/milesight-em410-rdl.pdf

### LoRaWAN Class

Class A

### LoRaWAN Protocol Version

LORAWAN_1_0_3

### Uplink Data Examples

fPort: 85 Payload: 03 67 EB 00 Temperature = 23.5 C
fPort: 85 Payload: 03 67 D3 FF Temperature = -4.5 C

### Decode Function (Optional)

```code
function Decoder(bytes, port) { var raw = bytes[2] | (bytes[3] << 8); if (raw & 0x8000) raw -= 0x10000; return { temperature: raw / 10 }; }
```

### Downlink Support

No - uplink only

### BACnet Object Mapping Requirements

Temperature -> AnalogInputObject (degreesCelsius)

### Priority

Medium
